title: Expose in Public
next_chapter_hook: The sect border's protective formation suddenly shuddered violently, countless black shadows pouring from the clouds—the "receptionists" Zhang Shen had mentioned, had finally arrived.

text.content: "Sword light like silk, piercing through the air. Chen Ji's feet remained still, yet his body strangely shifted three inches to the right. The blade that should have pierced his back grazed past his robes, stirring a cold wind that ruffled the hair at his temples. His movements flowed naturally, as if he had known all along where this strike would come from. He turned, his gaze as calm as a deep pool. Zhang Shen held his long sword, the tip still trembling slightly, his face full of disbelief. His sure-kill strike had been so easily dodged by this waste? "Elder Zhang," Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present, "During the ceremony, striking down a fellow disciple with deadly intent—what kind of rule is this?"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Zhang Shen gritted his teeth, his sword blade turning to strike again. "You waste, dare to slander me! Today I shall cleanse the sect for you!" Yet just as his sword intent rose, an old voice thundered like lightning—"Stop." Ling Yuan had somehow appeared beside the high platform, robes billowing, his murky old eyes flickering with complex light. His gaze swept between Chen Ji and Zhang Shen, finally settling on the sword still pointing at Chen Ji. "Zhang Shen, during the grand ceremony, what is the meaning of this?"

text.content: Zhang Shen's face changed dramatically, quickly sheathing his sword as he bowed: "Founder, understand! This waste learned some evil technique from somewhere, and dared to humiliate me in front of everyone. I was momentarily provoked..." His voice trembled slightly, fine beads of cold sweat appearing at his temples. Chen Ji watched him quietly, a faint smile curving his lips. That smile, in Zhang Shen's eyes, was more terrifying than any threat. "Elder Zhang," Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, each step seeming to step on Zhang Shen's heart, "You say I humiliated you. Then I dare ask—" He drew a jade slip from his sleeve, holding it high. "Secret dealings with the Xuanwu Sect, discussing the sect ceremony's sneak attack—does that count as humiliation?"

dialogue.content: The jade slip gleamed softly in the morning light, dense符文 and text faintly visible within. The entire arena erupted in uproar. The Xuanwu Sect—one of the three great sects, long rivaling the Tianqing Sect. If Zhang Shen had truly colluded with the Xuanwu Sect, this was outright treason! Zhang Shen's pupils contracted sharply, his voice cutting through the murmurs like a razor: "Ridiculous! This jade slip must be a forgery!" Chen Ji shook his head, disappointment evident in his tone: "Elder Zhang, you and I both know this jade slip came from the third layer of your secret chamber. It bears your spiritual consciousness mark—how could anyone else forge it?" He extended the jade slip toward Ling Yuan: "Please, Founder, examine it."

text.content: Ling Yuan received the jade slip, his spiritual sense probing its depths. After a moment, his expression completely darkened. Those murky old eyes suddenly blazed with terrifying killing intent. The details of the secret chamber and spiritual consciousness mark—unless one had personally retrieved it, such specifics were impossible to know. "Zhang Shen." Ling Yuan's voice seemed to emanate from the deepest abyss, ice-cold and bone-chilling: "In the jade slip, you and the Xuanwu Sect conspired to use the ceremony as a cover, launching a surprise attack at the third hour of the ox, promising to split the sect's secret treasures equally afterward... Do you have anything to say?" The surrounding disciples completely erupted into chaos. "Traitor!" "Zhang Shen actually colluded with external enemies!" "Where are the Xuanwu Sect people?"

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen's face turned ashen, stumbling backward several steps. His gaze frantically swept his surroundings, seemingly searching for something—the reinforcements who should have arrived on time. But all he received in return were increasingly chaotic murmurs and more and more angry glares directed at him. "I... I'm not..." His Adam's apple bobbed, his voice hoarse as if scraped by sandpaper. "Founder, there are extenuating circumstances! This jade slip is clearly a frame-up! I've been loyal to the sect, through countless summers and winters..." Chen Ji clapped lightly, the sound crisp. "What loyalty indeed." His tone was flat, yet every word cut like a knife. "Then Elder Zhang, explain—what about that unsent letter in your secret chamber three days ago?"

text.content: Zhang Shen's face drained of color instantly. Chen Ji produced another yellowed letter from his sleeve, unfolding it publicly. The calligraphy was elegant and spirited, clearly stating— "Xuanwu Sect friends: The Tianqing ceremony approaches, I have made all preparations. At that time, use the fireworks as signal. At the third hour of the ox, your forces infiltrate from the eastern cliff, I shall personally go to the protective formation's pivot point to shut it down. With coordination from within and without, great success is assured..." The letter's end bore Zhang Shen's private seal. The crowd erupted in thunderous fury. "Kill this traitor!" "Our Tianqing Sect harbors such a disgrace!" "And he always pretended to be loyal and righteous!" Countless furious True Qi fluctuations surged across the plaza, disciples' eyes bloodshot, if not for Ling Yuan's presence they would have swarmed forward.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression was dreadful. He slowly turned, his gaze shooting toward Zhang Shen like lightning: "Do you have anything to say?" Zhang Shen's entire body trembled, lips quivering, yet not a single word emerged. At this moment, he clearly understood—he was finished. Evidence was ironclad, caught red-handed. Decades of reputation, a lifetime of scheming, all turned to ashes in mere moments. His gaze fell on Chen Ji, eyes filled with unwillingness and venom. It was this waste... this waste who should have been easily manipulated by him... "You..." his voice was hoarse, "How did you find out..." Chen Ji tilted his head slightly, a knowing smile playing at his lips: "Elder Zhang, you didn't think—you were the only one in this world who could lay plans?"

text.content: These words resonated deeply with everyone present. Beside the high platform, a black-cloaked figure stood quietly—it was Ye Qing. Her light veil fluttered slightly, revealing a sliver of fair chin. In those ink-dark eyes, the plaza's chaos was reflected, a playful arc curling at her lips. Plans. When had this waste disciple begun laying plans? The disciples' murmuring gradually shifted. Many began re-examining Chen Ji—this waste disciple once ridiculed by all, today's performance was truly astonishing. Not only had he uncovered Zhang Shen's treasonous plot in advance, he had obtained ironclad evidence, and even seemed to have foreseen today's situation long ago. Could a waste really accomplish all this? "Chen Ji..." someone whispered, "Who is he really?"

choice.prompt: Zhang Shen had been utterly disgraced, but his reinforcements had yet to appear. How do you choose to conclude this exposure?

text.content: "Chen Ji stepped forward, his voice turning cold: 'Elder Zhang, you said I humiliated you—truly humiliating you has always been your own actions. Colluding with external enemies, betraying fellow disciples, scheming against disciples... which of these charges is me slandering you?' His words cut like blades, each one striking at the heart. 'You have been in the Tianqing Sect for fifty-three years, receiving countless kindnesses from the sect. Today you would deliver the entire sect into the tiger's mouth. I must ask—who is truly humiliating whom?'"

Zhang Shen's body shook violently, a mouthful of blood erupting forth. Not from injury—from rage. Being humiliated by a waste he had never regarded, having his most proud "loyalty and righteousness" torn to shreds before everyone. This humiliation was worse than death. "Chen Ji... you..." his eyes were bloodshot, "Your heart is truly vicious!" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "The feeling is mutual."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan finally spoke, his voice like cold ice: "Zhang Shen, evidence is ironclad, what defense do you have?" He waved his hand, several strands of True Qi transformed into chains binding Zhang Shen's four limbs. "Drag to the sect confinement chamber, await judgment!" Yet at this moment, a trace of madness flashed across Zhang Shen's face. He suddenly threw his head back and howled, the sound凄厉刺耳—"Come! All of you come! You think Zhang Shen came alone?!" His laughter grew increasingly mad. "The reinforcements are already hiding outside the sect! Without my signal they wouldn't act—but now..." He bit his tongue sharply, spraying essence blood into the sky, transforming into a blinding crimson light! "Xuanwu Sect friends, strike now!"

text.content:
Chen Ji slightly bowed, presenting the Jade Slip and Letter: "This disciple merely wishes to prevent the sect from suffering catastrophe. These pieces of evidence are all gifts from providence. Regarding Elder Zhang's matter, please let the Sect Master decide."

His posture was humble and proper, casually downplaying the "credit."

Whispers rippled through the crowd: "This Chen Ji... he knows how to read the room."

Ling Yuan took the evidence, his expression dark. He gazed deeply at Chen Ji, something hidden in those eyes that was quickly concealed.

"Bring Zhang Shen down!"

dialogue.content:
However, at this moment, Ling Yuan's movement paused.

He looked at Zhang Shen, a faint trace of... hesitation flickering in his eyes?

"Zhang Shen," his voice suddenly dropped several tones, "do you know your crime?"

This sentence seemed harsh, but it gave Zhang Shen an opportunity to speak.

Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed. Was the Sect Master... giving him a way out?

Indeed, Zhang Shen grabbed this lifeline, scrambling to the ground: "Spare my life, Sect Master! This subordinate was wrong! This subordinate is willing to atone for crimes with meritorious service!"

A commotion immediately arose among the crowd—someone present showed a thoughtful expression, their gaze toward Chen Ji becoming subtle.

text.content:
Chen Ji quietly watched this scene, a cold smile in his heart.

Ling Yuan, ah Ling Yuan, as expected of your old self.

Zhang Shen had cultivated his power within the Tianqing Sect for many years, with numerous factions under his influence. If he were publicly executed now, it might shake the sect's foundations. Ling Yuan's choice of "lenient punishment" seemed reasonable on the surface, but in truth was giving Zhang Shen breathing room.

Even... warning him, Chen Ji.

—You've stolen the spotlight today, but don't forget who the true master of this sect is.

Chen Ji lowered his eyelids, concealing the coldness in his eyes.

No matter. He never expected to take Zhang Shen's life today anyway. This game today was merely a stone thrown to test the waters. The true performance... was just beginning.

The sky suddenly darkened.

Not clouds covering the sun, but countless figures breaking through the air from the eastern Cliff Edge. A pressing black mass, over several hundred people, each with fierce aura and murderous intent surging to the heavens.

At their head was a middle-aged man in dark armor, surrounded by deep cyan True Qi, unmistakably a high-ranking elder of the Xuanwu Sect.

"Zhang Shen!" the armored man laughed loudly, "Did you send the signal? Our Xuanwu Sect heroes have been waiting!"

The plaza erupted into chaos.

Disciples fled in terror in all directions. Elders sacrificed their treasures one after another, True Qi fluctuations shaking the air itself.

And Zhang Shen—this traitor who moments ago had been as miserable as one whose parents had just died—now seemed to grasp a lifeline, laughing wildly.

"Hahaha! They're here! The reinforcements are here!" Tears streamed down his face from laughing, "Chen Ji! You thought you'd won? Today, the Tianqing Sect—"

Ling Yuan's expression turned ashen.

He never expected Zhang Shen to actually dare summon foreign enemies during the ceremony. This desperate move completely disrupted his plans.

"The sect's protective formation!" he roared, "Quick, activate the sect's protective formation!"

However, the next moment, a cold report came from the distance—

"Reporting to the Sect Master! The eastern pivot has been destroyed; the sect's protective formation... cannot be activated!"

Ling Yuan's body swayed, his face instantly turning pale.

Zhang Shen had actually prepared in advance, even sabotaging the formation's pivot beforehand!

The armored man stood in mid-air, overlooking the chaotic Tianqing Sect, his smile growing more得意: "Fellow Daoists of the Tianqing Sect, those who are wise will乖乖投降! Our Xuanwu Sect came only to eliminate traitors, unwilling to create unnecessary slaughter—"

Before he finished speaking, a sharp sword light suddenly blazed, directly striking his face!

From within the sword light, a black-clothed figure flickered like a specter.

It was Ye Qing.

dialogue.content:
"Demon Path witch!" The armored man cried out in shock and fury, retreating several steps to barely dodge the lethal strike, "Does your Holy Sect dare meddle in Xuanwu Sect affairs!"

Ye Qing floated in mid-air, demonic energy churning around her, her voice cold as ice: "Meddle? Did the Xuanwu Sect ask for the Holy Sect's opinion before attempting to monopolize the Tianqing Sect's secrets?"

The armored man's expression changed drastically: "What? Your Holy Sect also..."

Ye Qingsneered一声，不再多言，纤手一挥——

只见数十道黑影从她身后闪出，个个气息profound，竟然也是nascent soul期以上的高手！

原本以为自己稳操胜券的玄武宗众人，脸色瞬间变得精彩起来。

螳螂捕蝉，黄雀在后。谁也没想到，这一场闹剧，竟然还有第三方势力介入！

text.content:
On the plaza, the situation completely spun out of control.

Xuanwu Sect forces, Holy Sect ambush troops, Tianqing Sect elders and disciples... three factions clashed like interlocking teeth, True Qi fluctuations surging skyward, turning the entire ceremony grounds upside down.

Yet Chen Ji, at the epicenter of this storm, stood unmoving like a reef.

His gaze passed through the chaotic crowd, landing on the armored man suspended in mid-air, a faint smile curving his lips.

As expected... everything proceeded as he anticipated.

Zhang Shen was merely a chess piece; the Xuanwu Sect was merely another piece. The one who truly set up this game had always been him—

And that "Master Mo" who remained always in the shadows.

"Little friend," that elderly voice suddenly echoed in his mind, "the first move has been played. Now—it depends on your choice."

Chen Ji slightly narrowed his eyes, offering no response.

He took a step forward, facing the incoming chaos and killing intent, slowly walking toward the center of the battlefield.

It was time for him to take the stage.

choice.prompt: Three forces clash in chaos; you are the only one who clearly understands the full picture. How do you choose to act?

text.content:
Chen Ji's form flickered, his entire person darting through the chaos like a specter.

He was too fast.

So fast that even those Nascent Soul stage elders could only catch a blur.

Zhang Shen was desperately trying to escape outward, attempting to flee this dangerous place in the confusion. However, the next moment, a slender hand clamped onto the back of his neck.

"Elder Zhang," Chen Ji's voice sounded beside his ear, gentle yet hair-raisingly sinister, "where do you think you're going?"

Zhang Shen's entire body froze, his pupils reflecting a cold, gleaming short sword.

"Chen... Chen Ji... Spare my life..."

Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Sorry, too late."

Sword light flashed.

Zhang Shen's voice cut off abruptly, his head tumbling to the ground and rolling several times in a pool of blood.

The Tianqing Sect traitor was executed.

The surrounding disciples were stunned.

They had personally witnessed that usually meek and incompetent disciple execute an elder with thunderous efficiency!

Those fluid movements, that calm gaze, that毫不hesitated的剑法... where was there a shred oftrash模样？

"Chen Ji... he..."

"He was actually a master hiding his true abilities!"
"What ruthless methods! What swift movement technique!"

Exclamations rose one after another; everyone's gaze toward Chen Ji had changed.

Chen Ji merely淡淡地甩了甩剑上的血迹，转身望向半空中仍在对峙的各方势力。

He raised his hand, holding Zhang Shen's head high.

"Tianqing Sect traitor Zhang Shen, executed!" His voice was clear and carried in all directions, "Those of his faction who wish to surrender may receive lenient treatment; those who persist in their folly—"

His gaze swept across those panicked Zhang Shen loyalists, coldly吐出两个字：

"同罪。"

text.content:
Chen Ji quietly retreated several steps, disappearing into the crowd.

His form seemed so insignificant amid the chaos, so unremarkable. Even the masters locked in combat had no attention to spare for this "ordinary disciple."

Yet his gaze remained coolly fixed on every corner of the battlefield.

The Xuanwu Sect armored man clashed intensely with Ye Qing, True Qi fluctuations席卷四方; Ling Yuan led Tianqing Sect elders forming battle formations, barely resisting the pincer attack from both sides; and those Zhang Shen loyalists, some fighting desperately while others had already begun quietly fleeing...

The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.

And he, Chen Ji, intended to be the one holding the bow.

"Master Mo," he whispered in his heart, "your 'choice'—is this it?"

Master Mo's voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of praise: "Correct. The timing isn't right yet; it's fine to wait some more. True chess masters never reveal themselves lightly."

On the battlefield, the situation took a sharp turn.

Though the Xuanwu Sect was powerful, the Holy Sect masters Ye Qing brought were clearly better prepared. Under Ye Qing's strange "Demon Path Mist," the Xuanwu Sect cultivators' True Qi circulation was constantly hindered, their combat effectiveness greatly reduced.

"Damn it!" The armored man roared, "What evil technique is this Demon Path witch cultivating!"

Ye Qing laughed lightly, her voice pleasant as silver bells yet carrying bone-deep chill: "This mist of mine specializes in countering your so-called righteous techniques. The more you struggle, the deeper you sink."

She waved her jade-like hand, and a black chain suddenly wrapped around two Xuanwu Sect elders, strangling them to death!

Blood filled the battlefield; the Xuanwu Sect's offensive immediately stalled.

And at this moment—

A massive crack suddenly tore through the sky. A terrifying pressure poured down from the rift, pressing down on everyone present until they couldn't breathe.

"What insects," a cold voice drifted from the rift, "dare cause mischief under my very eyes?"

That voice...

Chen Ji's pupils constricted.

This voice... why was it so familiar?

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's expression instantly changed.

She abruptly looked up at the rift splitting the heavens, fear flashing in her eyes.

"Impossible... why would he personally appear..."

The armored man's face also changed dramatically, blurting out: "Heaven's Eye!"

The moment these four characters fell, the entire battlefield fell silent.

Heaven's Eye—that terrifying existence above all factions, said to control the heavenly will of the entire cultivation world. Its envoys were everywhere, monitoring every existence that might threaten the "Heavenly Order."

And now... it had actually descended personally?

Chen Ji's heart raced violently.

An inexplicable sense of crisis rose in his heart, as if something he didn't know about was unfolding in a way he couldn't predict...

"Chen Ji." Master Mo's voice suddenly became extremely grave, "Plans have changed. Whatever happens next—do not act rashly."

From that rift in the heavens, a massive eye slowly opened.

Cold, utterly emotionless gaze swept over everyone present—

Finally, it fixed upon Chen Ji.

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing, join forces to stabilize the situation
choices.description: Seize the chaos to establish deeper cooperation with Ye Qing, jointly address the unexpected situation
choices.visible_cost: Being exposed as having connections with the Demonic Path may provoke hostility from righteous sect forces
choices.visible_reward: Establishing a solid alliance with Ye Qing, gaining support from a strategic-level ally
choices.risk_hint: May be regarded by Ling Yuan as colluding with the Demonic Path

text.content:
Chen Ji's figure flickered, dashing through the chaos toward Ye Qing's direction.

Ye Qing was locked in fierce combat with the armored man, catching a glimpse of Chen Ji's approach with her peripheral vision. She frowned slightly: "What are you doing here?"

Chen Ji offered no answer, instead directly transmitting through divine sense: "The situation has changed. Xuanwu Sect is merely the vanguard. The real trouble—hasn't arrived yet."

Ye Qing's pupils constricted.

She knew Chen Ji possessed some kind of foresight ability. His words here meant—

"What do you want to do?" she asked.

Chen Ji replied calmly: "You and I join hands. First, stabilize the situation. Whatever changes come next, we must hold our ground."

Ye Qing gazed at him for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh: "Youtrash, far more reliable than those so-called righteous cultivators."

She flicked her delicate hand, and a demonic energy barrier formed around the two of them, sealing out the chaos.

"Very well. I'll trust you this once."

Under their combined efforts, the battlefield situation rapidly stabilized.

Ye Qing's Demonic Path mists could effectively suppress the true elemental circulation of Xuanwu Sect experts, while Chen Ji, despite his seemingly meager cultivation, always managed to identify enemy weaknesses at critical moments, guiding Tianqing Sect disciples in counterattacks.

Orthodox and heretical, light and shadow, their coordination was flawless.

The armored man grew more and more alarmed with each exchange. He discovered that some unknown "helper" had appeared beside the Demonic Path Saintess. That person's movement technique was bizarre—always appearing at the most fatal position at the most fatal moment.

"Who is that小子?" he shouted furiously.

Ye Qing sneered: "Someone more trustworthy than any of you self-proclaimed righteous cultivators."

She exchanged a glance with Chen Ji, and their offensive suddenly intensified!

The armored man's expression changed dramatically as he was forced backward repeatedly.

Just then, an explosive roar echoed from the sky—

From the Formation Hub at the mountain's protective array, a brilliant golden light shot skyward!

Someone... had activated the backup formation!

The golden light descended, enveloping the entire Tianqing Sect.

The Xuanwu Sect cultivators' faces instantly turned ashen—under this golden light's suppression, their cultivation had been forcibly weakened by thirty percent!

"This is... the sect's supreme formation, 'Heavenly Net and Earthly Web'!" someone shrieked in terror.

Ling Yuan stood atop the high platform, his expression unchanged as he surveyed the battlefield.

Although caught off guard by the three-way chaos just now, he was after all a sect master. Would a sect like Tianqing Sect, established for thousands of years, have no contingency plans?

"Esteemed members of Xuanwu Sect," his voice, empowered by the golden light, rang like heavenly judgment, "Today's matter, this one has taken note. In time to come, I shall certainly pay a visit to your doorstep."

The armored man's face turned iron-green, knowing today's objective was beyond reach. He coldly snorted: "Retreat!"

Hundreds of black shadows receded like a tide, vanishing into the clouds in the blink of an eye.

And that golden light rising from the hub, after confirming the external enemies had withdrawn, slowly dissipated.

But Chen Ji noticed—

In the instant the golden light vanished, Ling Yuan's gaze had fallen upon him and Ye Qing.

The meaning hidden in that gaze made his heart tighten.

"Little friend," Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded softly, "Ling Yuan... has already begun to suspect you."

Ye Qing收起魔气, turning to glance at Chen Ji.

"Today's matter, consider me owing you a favor." Her voice returned to its usual cold detachment, "If you ever need anything in the future, don't hesitate to ask."

Chen Ji gave a slight nod: "The Saintess is too kind. But when that armored man mentioned 'Heaven's Eye' just now, the Saintess seemed... quite concerned?"

Ye Qing's eyelashes trembled slightly, then calm returned.

"Some things," she didn't answer directly, "The less you know now, the better."

She turned to leave, but paused at the final moment.

"Chen Ji," she suddenly spoke, voice pressed extremely low, "If one day, you discover that the person you trust most has actually been using you all along—"

She didn't finish, her form already vanishing on the spot.

Leaving only a faint lingering fragrance and a meaningful, unfinished ending.

Chen Ji stood alone where she had been, gazing toward where she disappeared, his gaze deep and dark.

The person I trust most... indeed?

He lowered his eyelids, a self-mocking smile curling at the corner of his mouth.

The person he trusted most had always been only himself. As for Mo Xiansheng—

That was merely a cooperative relationship of mutual benefit.

"Mo Xiansheng," he asked softly in his heart, "May I ask... can I still trust you?"

Long silence filled his mind.

When that silence finally broke, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded more exhausted than ever before:

"Little friend, the answer to this question—perhaps is more complicated than you imagine."

"Some things aren't about whether to trust or not. Rather—Are you willing, for some goal, to keep walking this path?"

"Even if the end of that road is a深渊 you never imagined."

Chen Ji fell silent.

In the distance, sect disciples were cleaning up the aftermath. Zhang Shen's body was carried away, the bloodstains on the ground gradually being scrubbed clean.

The ceremony had become ruins, but Tianqing Sect's foundations remained.

And Chen Ji—after today, would never again be able to play the role of the bulliedtrash.

A new game of chess was about to begin.

Just then, the earth suddenly violent shook.

"What's happening?!"
"East side! It's the east side cliff direction!"

In the panicked shouts, a massive rift tore open from the sect's border. Countless black shadows poured forth from the fissure, surging toward Tianqing Sect like a tide.

Those black shadows emanated concentrated demonic energy, yet it was entirely different from Ye Qing's techniques—more berserk, more chaotic, carrying a madness to destroy everything.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

The reinforcements Zhang Shen summoned... weren't from Xuanwu Sect!

Xuanwu Sect was merely the obvious chess piece. The true killing blow—was this hidden demonic force!

"Mo Xiansheng!" heurgent called in his heart.

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried unprecedented gravity: "Little friend, the situation has gone out of control. The aura of this force... doesn't seem like an ordinary demonic sect."

"It resembles—the things sealed within the Ancient Forbidden Land."

Ancient Forbidden Land?

Chen Ji suddenly recalled the setting from the scroll's beginning—three major sects clashing, demonic path invasion, Ancient Forbidden Land opening.

So... this was the trigger for "the Ancient Forbidden Land opening"?

He tightly clenched his fist, his mind racing through countermeasures.

And that demonic black tide was getting closer and closer...

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's expression completely darkened.

Just now he had activated the Heavenly Net and Earthly Web, intimidating Xuanwu Sect, thinking the overall situation was settled. Yet who would have thought the true crisis was only arriving now.

Each of those black shadows pouring from the rift emanated a terrifying aura. The strongest among them actually showed signs of breaking through to late Nascent Soul stage!

If this force charged into the sect...

"All elders, receive orders!" he厉喝出声, "Form formation and receive the enemy!"

Yet the elders looked at each other in dismay. The just-ended chaos had already depleted them greatly. Facing this sudden black tide, they actually felt somewhat powerless.

Ling Yuan's gaze swept across everyone present, finally landing on Chen Ji.

That gaze flickered with complexity—scrutiny, wariness, and a trace of... something indescribable.

"Chen Ji," he suddenly spoke, voice revealing neither pleasure nor anger, "You've rendered great service today. This one shall certainly reward you. But now—"

He turned sharply: "This one orders you to immediately proceed to the east cliff, investigate the origins of this force."

At these words, everyone gasped.

Sending a servant disciple to investigate that terrifying demonic force?

This... was clearly sending him to his death!

Yet Chen Ji merely smiled faintly, bowing to Ling Yuan.

"Disciple... receives orders."

text.content:
A trace of astonishment flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes.

He had expected Chen Ji to make excuses, to beg for mercy, to show terror. Yet this小子 actually accepted this必死mission so readily.

Was it a case of having nothing left to lose? Or... did he have some other reliance?

He gazed deeply at Chen Ji, then suddenly said: "This one will send a few elders to accompany you."

This statement seemed kind on the surface, but in reality—

It was surveillance.

Chen Ji coldly laughed in his heart, his expression betraying nothing: "Many thanks, Sect Master."

He turned and walked toward the sect border direction, his steps unhurried, as if not heading to his death, but to an ordinary appointment.

The surrounding disciples watched his departing figure, their expressions complex.

Thistrash who had been mocked by everyone, today displayed astonishing strategy and resolve, and now the Sect Master had dispatched him on a life-threatening mission...

Who was he really?

Where would his destiny lead?

No one knew the answer.

Only Chen Ji himself was clear—

This was merely one move in a much larger chess game.

Did Ling Yuan think to use him as a probing piece?

Heh, then let Ling Yuan see who was truly the chess player.

The rift at the sect border was growing larger and larger, that demonic black tide's aura getting closer and closer.

An even greater storm was about to arrive.
